findings.fix: Use `simp only` with the rewrites actually needed and close with `module` (the tactic already used elsewhere in this PR for ℂ-module goals).
findings.issue: The closing step is a nonterminal default `simp` with a hand-tuned eleven-lemma scalar-shuffling list (`smul_tmul, tmul_smul, tmul_neg, neg_tmul, two_smul, smul_smul`) followed by `<;> abel`, so it is unclear which of the four branches `simp` closes and which `abel` does; `abel` also ignores the ℂ-scalars the rewrites were inserted to move.

summary: The mathematics is carried by a few reusable algebraic facts (the exchange operator is an involution and commutes with the pair action; `toEuclideanLin` is multiplicative; the Pauli columns) that are never isolated — instead each consequence is re-derived element-wise through `TensorProduct.ext'` or by unfolding `mulVec`/`dotProduct`/`Matrix.trace`. Factoring these out would shorten the proofs and remove the entry-level unfolding they currently rest on.
